cityStatistic.sourceTitle: How Much Do Hotels Cost in Cape Town? Hotel Prices for Cape Town, South Africa | Budget Your Trip
cityStatistic.evidenceText: With data for 38 fantastic hotels, $69 is the average price for 1-star hotels in Cape Town, and the median price is $55.
cityStatistic.referencePeriod: Budget Your Trip hotel-price analysis; result crawled last month (July 2026); 1-star sample of 38 hotels
cityStatistic.searchQuery: site:budgetyourtrip.com Cape Town South Africa 1 star hotel average price
cityStatistic.reason: The exact-city BudgetYourTrip hotel analysis identifies the 1-star class, gives a non-from city average in USD, and exposes a 38-hotel sample. Occupancy remains unknown_source_default; this is calibration evidence only and is not an observed two-adult product anchor.

explicitQuotesReason: The Booking.com search returned exact Cape Town properties with two-adult room prices, but none was explicitly identified as a 1-star property. The Hotels.com search returned 2-star and higher properties and one-star-filter results without a qualifying named one-star two-adult quote. Generic hotel and non-one-star results were rejected, and no value was mapped to the city statistic.
